subject: literature
title: GCSE Literature - Animal Farm Chapter 8: The Battle of the Windmill
description: A source-faithful revision pack on Chapter 8 of Animal Farm, centred on the Battle of the Windmill and Orwell's presentation of power. It covers plot events, methods, themes, and key interpretations linked to exploitation, propaganda, irony, and dictatorship.

data.title: Events of the Battle of the Windmill
data.instruction: Put the main events of Chapter 8 in the correct order.
items: Napoleon finalises the timber sale to Frederick.
The animals discover that Frederick's banknotes are forged.
Frederick and his men invade Animal Farm.
The attackers blow up the windmill with explosives.
The animals launch a furious counter-attack.
Napoleon and Squealer present the outcome as a victory.

data.title: How Orwell Shows Dictatorship
data.instruction: Order these stages of control from rule-making to manipulation.
items: The pigs take authority over the farm.
They alter the Commandments to excuse their privileges.
Squealer rewrites events through speeches and statistics.
The animals struggle to trust their own memories.
